SASBDB entry SASDMB6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDMB6/)

Publication: Long promoter sequences form higher-order G-quadruplexes: an integrative structural biology study of c-Myc, k-Ras and c-Kit promoter sequences.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkac182

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDMB6.dat   the curve (q in 1/A; columns q, I, error)
  SASDMB6_fit1.fit               the CRYSOL fit (q in 1/A; columns q, Iexp, Ierr, Icalc)
  SASDMB6_fit1_model1.pdb        the atomic model of "fit1" (the 6L92 G-quadruplex with hydrogens and K+ ions)
                            (https://www.sasbdb.org/media/pdb_file/SASDMB6_fit1_model1.pdb)
Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDMB6/ cites the buffer (BPEK) from the SASBDB entry; the paper was not
consulted again for this entry (same deposition as SASDM96 and SASDM76).
Buffer (2026-11-13, papers are the source of truth): the paper (Monsen et al., NAR 2022) states BPEK
potassium phosphate, 185 mM KCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 7.2, 22 C, 1.033 A; the script uses potassium
phosphates (6 mM K2HPO4 + 2 mM KH2PO4, SASBDB concentrations) instead of the SASBDB sodium salts.
